business: SEGMENT: PI car accident intake, Pleasanton (Shotland pilot)
prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
competitors_mentioned: Alameda County Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service
answer_verbatim:
I can’t responsibly name one “best” lawyer without knowing the injury severity and case details. A good first step is to get **two or three consultations** and compare the lawyers who would actually handle your case.

For a neutral starting point, the **Alameda County Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service** can refer you to personal-injury attorneys. It lists a **$40 administrative fee** and an initial consultation of up to 30 minutes; you’re not obligated to hire the lawyer. Call **510-302-2222, option 1**, or use its [online referral service](https://www.acbanet.org/need-a-lawyer/). The California State Bar also explains how its certified referral services work: [Find a Lawyer Referral Service](https://www.calbar.ca.gov/public/find-legal-professionals/find-lawyer-referral-service).

When you speak with attorneys, ask:
- Who will personally handle my case, and how often will I hear from them?
- Have you handled cases like mine, especially if there are serious injuries or disputed fault?
- What is the contingency fee, and what case costs might I owe if there’s no recovery?
- What are the strengths, risks, and likely next steps in my case?

Before signing, verify the lawyer’s license and status through the [State Bar of California](https://apps.calbar.ca.gov/attorney/LicenseeSearch/QuickSearch). Be cautious about anyone promising a specific settlement.

If you’re injured, prioritize medical care, keep records and receipts, and avoid giving a recorded statement to the other driver’s insurer before getting advice. If you tell me how serious your injuries are, whether fault is disputed, and whether you’ve already spoken with an insurer, I can help you narrow down what kind of attorney to look for.
